name: K-C Chester Mill - Chester PA
type: Non-integrated tissue mill (Scott 1000 bathroom tissue; ~1.3M sq ft, ~570 employees)

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed K-C Chester non-integrated tissue mill (Scott 1000), ~74 acres on the Delaware River. Roster coord (39.8416,-75.3694) sat ~1 km W of the actual mill in downtown Chester. Resolved via the documented border 'East by Harrah's Casino and Race Track' — the mill is the large dense paper-mill complex immediately W of Harrah's Philadelphia racetrack oval, at ~39.844,-75.357. Address 800 W 2nd St, Chester PA 19013.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The mill is fully perimeter chain-link fenced (visible all along W 2nd St in Street View). Trucks enter through fence gates; the main entrance off W 2nd St (~39.846,-75.357) opens into the mill yard. Classed truckGate true; a hard barrier arm was not clearly resolved.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth positively confirmed at the W 2nd St entrance — the entry reads as an open fence gate into a parking/yard area. A small white-roofed structure in the freight yard near the rail siding (~39.8446,-75.3576) may be a scale house or gatehouse. Classed guardShack false / remoteGs true; listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.scale: A small structure beside the rail siding in the freight yard is consistent with a truck scale / scale house, but cannot be confirmed — listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail tracks run into and through the mill property (siding visible by the freight yard and along the complex) — classed rail-served.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No dedicated trailer drop yard — dense urban mill with no room for a trailer storage lot. Only a few trailers parked near the dock building.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Compact shipping dock on the warehouse building; ~18 doors estimated — listed uncertain (mill is dense and partly obscured by overhead conveyors).
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Tight urban site hemmed in by the river, Harrah's casino, and city streets — little truck stacking room; a queue would spill onto W 2nd St.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of multiple connected buildings — mill, converting/warehouse, cogeneration plant, wastewater treatment — linked by overhead pipe/conveyor bridges.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense urban waterfront in Chester, in the Philadelphia metro — Urban.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: At least two fence-gate entries observed (W 2nd St main entrance and a freight-yard access); listed uncertain.

citations.claim: Chester mill produces ~2M rolls/day of Scott 1000 = 60% of US Scott 1000; ~570 employees.
Only the old coal-fired boiler building was demolished under a $150M coal-to-gas modernization; the Scott 1000 tissue mill (570 employees) remains operational.

verification.rationale: Mill operating; a demolition headline is a false-alarm trap (it was the coal boiler under a $150M modernization, not the mill); no closure/sale evidence.
